newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil July industry employment down 0.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil July industry employment down 0.3 pct.

text.p: Brazilian July industrial employment fell 0.3 percent from June and 11.2 percent compared with July 1995, the National Statistics Institute (IBGE) said.
Industrial employment fell 10.1 percent in the past 12 months and 12.6 percent in the first seven months of this year, the IBGE said in a statement.
The IBGE said July employment levels declined most in Rio de Janeiro state at 1.1 percent and least in Sao Paulo state at 0.1 percent.
The largest employment losses were in the tobacco, drinks and paper and cardboard sectors, the IBGE added.
Total salaries paid decreased as well for the second consecutive month, falling 0.4 percent from June and 8.1 percent in comparison with July last year.
The total number of hours paid in June fell 1.9 percent compared with May and 13 percent from June 1995.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
